'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Josh Mack DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
